title.en: Use σ² = mean of squares − square of mean

say.en: Absolute values are awkward in algebra. Squaring the deviations also removes the signs, and it leads to the most widely used measure of spread, the standard deviation. In this lesson: Compute variance and standard deviation.
Use sigma squared equals mean of squares - square of mean.

body.en: The variance is the mean of the squared deviations from the mean: $\sigma^2 = \frac1n\sum(x_i - \bar x)^2$. The *standard deviation* $\sigma$ is its positive square root and has the same units as the data. For a discrete frequency distribution, $\sigma^2 = \frac1N\sum f_i(x_i - \bar x)^2$.
body.kn: ಸರಾಸರಿಯಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನೆಗಳ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿಯೇ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ σ². ಅದರ ಧನ ವರ್ಗಮೂಲವೇ ಮಾನಕ ವಿಚಲನೆ σ; ಅದರ ಏಕಮಾನ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ಏಕಮಾನವೇ.

narration.en: Variance is the average of the squared deviations from the mean. Standard deviation, sigma, is its square root, in the same units as the data.

narration.en: Instead of ignoring signs, square each deviation from the mean. The average of the squares is the variance; its square root is the standard deviation.

say.en: Instead of ignoring signs, square each deviation from the mean. The average of the squares is the variance; its square root is the standard deviation.
For 6, 8, 10 up to 24, ten values with mean 15, the squared deviations add to 330. The variance is 33 and the standard deviation about 5.74.
A quicker form: the mean of the squares minus the square of the mean. Here 2580 over 10 is 258, minus 225 gives 33 again.
Adding the same number to every value shifts the data but does not change the spread. Multiplying every value by k multiplies sigma by mod k.

title.en: A handy form; effect of changes

body.en: Expanding the square gives $\sigma^2 = \frac1n\sum x_i^2 - \bar x^2$: the mean of the squares minus the square of the mean. Adding a constant to every value leaves $\sigma$ unchanged; multiplying every value by $k$ multiplies $\sigma$ by $|k|$ and $\sigma^2$ by $k^2$.
body.kn: ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ = ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿ − ಸರಾಸರಿಯ ವರ್ಗ. ಎಲ್ಲ ಬೆಲೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದರೆ σ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; k ಇಂದ ಗುಣಿಸಿದರೆ σ ಯು |k| ಪಟ್ಟು ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: The mean and variance of 7 observations are 8 and 16. Five of them are 2, 4, 10, 12, 14. Find the other two.

steps.en: Σx² = n(σ² + x̄²) = 7(16 + 64) = 560; known squares sum to 460, so x² + y² = 100.
x + y = 14 and x² + y² = 100 give xy = 48, so the numbers are 6 and 8.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The mean and variance of 7 observations are 8 and 16. Five of them are 2, 4, 10, 12, 14. Find the other two.

say.en: Let us solve this together. The mean and variance of 7 observations are 8 and 16. Five of them are 2, 4, 10, 12, 14. Find the other two.
Sum equals 56, so x plus y equals 56 minus 42 equals 14.
Σx squared equals n(sigma squared plus x̄ squared) equals 716 plus 64 equals 560; known squares sum to 460, so x squared plus y squared equals 100.
x plus y equals 14 and x squared plus y squared equals 100 give xy equals 48, so the numbers are 6 and 8.
So the answer is 6 and 8.
